integrity: Symbolic argument identifies all palindromic and antipalindromic circular factors via two parity-of-start decompositions and proves the exact exceptional overlap. An independently coded bounded enumerator checks every input and output length at ranks through nine; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only complete binary dyadic Thue–Morse iterates and distinct circular factors no longer than one period; no arbitrary prefixes or per-position multiplicities. Literature priority is not exhaustively established; an important circular-palindrome paper could only be evaluated from its accessible summary. Finite enumeration is not an infinite proof.
title: A complete circular-palindrome spectrum for dyadic Thue–Morse words
